outputDirectory.description: Build-root-relative report folder, without symlinks or junctions. Defaults to temp. The report must not overlap shard inputs.

reportFilename.description: Single JSON filename within outputDirectory. Defaults to jest-collated.json. Must not be shard-manifest.json.

junitOutputFile.description: Optional build-root-relative XML filename for collator-owned JUnit. Must not overlap shard inputs, JSON, or coverage outputs. Requires version 3 assertion details.
